IC4: 1. Recurring symptomatic monomorphic ventricular tachycardia that requires ICD intervention (e.g. shock or [NOT] anti-tachycardia stimulation). At least 3 episodes within the 3 months prior to inclusion [OR] or
IC5: 2. induction of symptomatic monomorphic ventricular tachycardia that requires ICD intervention (e.g. shock [OR] or [NOT] anti-tachycardia stimulation). Induction triggered by ICD or during electrophysiology studies (EPS) [OR] or both, a) and b)

IC8: - [NOT] No prior radiation therapy in the thorax area
IC9: - [NOT] No pregnancy [AND] and [NOT] no active breastfeeding
IC10: - Ability to consent and consent to study participation
